name: hungrybox
description: Hungry Box - multi-branch food delivery platform. First branch Guntur (AP, India); designed for additional branches without code changes.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hungrybox/shared && npm run build --workspace @hungrybox/api && npm run build --workspace @hungrybox/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @hungrybox/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @hungrybox/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @hungrybox/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @hungrybox/api && npm run lint --workspace @hungrybox/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @hungrybox/api && npm run test --workspace @hungrybox/web
